title: Legacy architecture compatibility normalization
description: Normalize released nodes/zones/boundaries/edges into Resources, Containers, Overlays, and direct communication candidates with provenance and migration diagnostics.
completion_criteria: Zone membership becomes one direct Container parent per Resource.
Legacy boundaries become explicit Overlay membership.
Subgraph and layer do not affect containment.
Manual boundaryCrossing is retained only as a comparable compatibility assertion.
triage_notes: DONE (Codex): added normalizeTopology() as the compatibility boundary from released ArchMapModel documents to the plugin-neutral Topology model. Nodes become Resources with one direct zone-derived parent; zones become Containers with deterministic nested-parent inference; boundaries become freely composable Overlays; graph edges become direct Resource-to-Resource communication candidates. Subgraph and layer remain provenance/extension metadata and never create containment. Legacy boundaryCrossing values are emitted only as comparable compatibility assertions and do not create derived Crossing records. Verification: npm run typecheck; focused topology tests (4 passing); npm run build; AOF organization verify 46/46.
